sections.heading: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN POLITICS AND INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS
lines: Enrollment in this module is limited. Meeting the minimum requirements does not guarantee that students wishing to transfer into this module will be offered enrollment.

Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 3.0 principal courses, including 1.0 Political Science course(s) at the 1000-level, plus 2.0 additional courses, with no mark in these principal courses below 60%.
1.0 course: Political Science 2237E or Political Science 2237W/X.
1.0 course: Political Science 2231E or Political Science 2231W/X.
1.0 course in Political Science at the 2200 level or above.
3.5 courses in Political Science at the 3000 or 4000 level, including a minimum of 0.5 at the 4000-level.
